code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, anemia, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, monocytosis, and basophilia. There is evidence of renal impairment (elevated creatinine), mild inflammation (elevated CRP, D-dimer, ferritin, LDH), and coagulopathy (elevated INR). Liver enzymes are mostly normal. The findings suggest acute systemic illness with hypoxia, cytopenias, and possible multi-organ involvement; urgent clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
